record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: For the integrable N = 2 super KdV equations SKdV_{-2} and SKdV_4, what is the precise relation between their two independent towers of fermionic nonlocal conservation laws and the corresponding Lax operator, given that the Lax operator has two distinct fourth roots but those roots have not been connected to the fermionic conserved quantities?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the N=2 supersymmetric Korteweg–de Vries equations on a superspace with one even coordinate x, time t, and two odd coordinates θ₁, θ₂. The dependent variable is a chiral N=2 superfield Φ(x,t,θ₁,θ₂) whose component expansion encodes one bosonic field and two fermionic fields together with an auxiliary bosonic field. The N=2 SKdV family is parametrized by a real constant a and is integrable precisely for a ∈ {−2, 1, 4}. For the two values a = −2 and a = 4, the integrable equation SKdV_a admits two independent infinite towers of fermionic nonlocal conservation laws; in each tower the lowest member is a fermionic nonlocal charge, and successive members are generated by the recursion operator of the hierarchy. The integrability of SKdV_a for a = −2 and a = 4 is encoded in a Lax operator L (a scalar pseudo-differential super-operator) which, in each of these two cases, admits two distinct fourth roots L^{1/4} as formal super-pseudo-differential operators.

Problem. For each of a = −2 and a = 4, determine the precise relation between the two independent towers of fermionic nonlocal conservation laws of SKdV_a and the two distinct fourth roots of the associated Lax operator L. In particular, exhibit, for each of the two fourth roots, an explicit construction (e.g., via residues, super-traces, or appropriate fractional powers of L) that produces the corresponding tower of fermionic nonlocal conserved densities, and show how the two towers are recovered from the two inequivalent choices of fourth root.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches retrieve work on nonlocal conservation laws and on extensions of the N=2 SKdV hierarchy associated with the nonuniqueness of roots of the Lax operator (e.g., Popowicz 1998), as well as the N=1 case where nonlocal charges are tied to powers of the fourth root of the Lax operator. However, no source explicitly establishing the full correspondence between the two fermionic nonlocal towers and the two fourth roots of the Lax operator for SKdV_{-2} and SKdV_4 was found, so the status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Integrable extensions of N=2 supersymmetric KdV hierarchy associated with the nonuniqueness of the roots of the Lax operator
status_evidence.snippet: The root of the supersymmetric Lax operator of the KdV equation is generalized... This generalized root generates a new hierarchy of integrable equations.
status_evidence.claim: Nonuniqueness of roots of the N=2 SKdV Lax operator has been used to build extended hierarchies, but the connection to the fermionic nonlocal towers is not established there.

status_evidence.title: Higher order supersymmetries and fermionic conservation laws of the supersymmetric extension of the KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: Fermionic nonlocal conservation laws for supersymmetric KdV are related to powers of the fourth root of the Lax operator in the N=1 case.
status_evidence.claim: An analogous correspondence is known in the N=1 case, motivating but not resolving the N=2 question.
